description: User-provided source photos for evaluating food-identity preservation, serving-ware improvement, and table-distraction cleanup.

cases.name: stir-fried udon is re-served cleanly without table clutter
expectedComposition: the serving bowl is centered in the frame
the complete bowl is visible with balanced margins
the dish is the clear hero of a polished restaurant-menu photograph
the simple tabletop or backdrop has no decorative props
chopsticks or other utensils do not cross over the bowl or food
expectedCleanup: all stains, sauce marks, or food residue on the serving bowl
cases.expectedServingWare: a visibly different, unstained, clean ceramic noodle bowl

cases.name: whole cooked shrimp are arranged on a clean serving plate
expectedAppearance: the original simple preparation without sauce
cases.expectedServingWare: a visibly different clean ceramic serving plate

cases.name: mixed vegetables move from takeout packaging to a clean platter
